e.body:
**IAAI Insurance Auto Auction Dataset**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22651165`）**是一份**由**商业**数据公司**按日**发布的**保险**残值**拍卖**样本**数据集****——**逐字自述为**「**Daily sample of IAAI insurance auto auction lots with damage assessments, title status, bidding data, and branch locations across North America.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**研究工件面**：用**研究**索引**找**窗口内**的**工件**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**样本**」与**「**全量**」**的**关系**被**写在**第一段**，**并**用**三个**相关**标识**标注**清楚****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**记录**逐字**写**「**This is a sample of the IAAI Insurance Auto Auction Dataset published by Rebrowser. The full dataset is updated daily. Browse, filter, and export the complete dataset at https://rebrowser.net/products/datasets/iaai**」**，**并**逐字**给出**相关**标识**（**逐字**：**isSupplementTo** 指向**产品**页、**isPartOf** 指向**数据集**系列、**isDocumentedBy** 指向**免费**数据集**说明**页、**isReferencedBy** 指向**定价**页）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条**最值得**记**的**：**⭐ 即**「**免费**给**你的**这一份**」**与**「**要**付费**的**那一份**」**之间**的**关系**，**可以**用**元数据**说**清**，**而**不**必**靠**读者**翻**产品**页**去**猜**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**这类**数据**时**要**写明**「**这是**样本**、**全量**在**哪**」**，**否则**结论**会**被**误**当成**全市**场**。
**⭐⭐ ② 许可**是**非商业**（**`cc-by-nc-4.0`**）**，**而**这**直接**限制**用途****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**许可**逐字**为 **`cc-by-nc-4.0`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**提示**：**⭐ 即**课程**作业**、**论文**与**内部**研究**通常**在**此**许可**下**可以**用**（**仍**需**署名**）**，**而**产品**化**、**对外**服务**或**商用**需**另行**取得**授权**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**把**数据集**写进**作品集**或**演示**时**，**要**在**页面**上**标**许可**与**出处**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 字段**覆盖**残值**车的**四个**面向**，**并**与**池内**另一家**拍卖行**形成**对照****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**列出**四类**字段**（**逐字**：**damage assessments, title status, bidding data, and branch locations**）**；**⭐ 记录**另**含 **`auction-listings_schema.json`（**13,611 B）**，**即**字段**定义**有**随**数据**发布**的 **schema** 文件**（**⚠️ 本次**未读**其**内容**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**「**损伤**评估」**与**「**权属**状态」**是**车险**全损**与**残值**处置**里**最**关键**的两**列**（**前者**影响**定损**、**后者**影响**能否**过户**与**再售**）**，**而**「**竞价**数据」**是**残值**价格**的**直接**证据**；**⭐ 与 **[[copart-salvage-dataset]]** 的**关系**是**「**两家**拍卖行**各**一份**公开**数据**」**——**⭐ 本词条**不对二者做**代码**或**字段**级比较**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 发布者**是**商业**数据**公司**，**而**不**是**研究**机构****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**创建者**逐字**为 **`Rebrowser`****，**并**含**指向**定价**页**的**相关**标识**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**它**的**发布**动机**是**让**研究**者与**开发者**先**用**样本**、**再**买**全量**——**⭐ 这**并**不**使**数据**不**可用**，**但**它**意味着**「**样本**的**覆盖面**、**时间**跨度**与**抽**样**方式**」**都**应**按**样本**自身**核对**，**而**不**应**假定**它**代表**全量**分布**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 窗口内的**多**版本**记录（**发现**路径**可复现）**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**同**标题**在**窗口内**出现**五**次**，**DOI** 逐字**为 **`10.5281/zenodo.22313126`（**09-05）**、**`22416042`（**09-06）**、**`22557816`（**09-07）**、**`18854631`（**09-08）** 与 **`22651165`（**09-08）****，**即**同一**数据集**的**多**版本**各自**有**独立 **DOI****；**⭐ 本词条**据**本条（**版本**逐字 **`2026-09-07`）**立条**，**并**如实**说明**这一**多**记录**现象**：**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用 **Zenodo** 数据**时**要**指明**版本**与 **DOI**，**而**不**要**只**写**数据集**名**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 覆盖**另一家**残值**拍卖**数据集**、**[[uk-vehicle-reliability-sample]] 覆盖**车辆**可靠性**样本**、**[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 覆盖**损伤**识别**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**商业**数据**公司**以**样本**引流**形式**发布的**残值**拍卖**数据**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **样本**与**全量**的**关系**要**在**引用**时**写明**；**② **许可**（**尤其**非商业**条款）要**随**数据**一起**标注**；**③ **残值**数据**看**四**列**（**损伤、**权属、**竞价、**地点）**；**④ **商业**来源**的**免费**样本**要**核对**其**抽样**方式**；**⑤ **Zenodo** 引用**要**带**版本**与 **DOI**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其**任何 **CSV**（**未**打开 **README** 文件**内容**、**未**统计**行数**与**字段**分布**）**，**故**不主张**其**数据**质量**、**字段**完整性**或**样本**代表性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo 记录接口返回的**元数据**（**标题、**描述、**版本、**许可、**创建者、**文件**名与**字节数、**相关**标识）**，**未读**其 **README** 正文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**每日**更新**」**是否**持续**（**⭐ 本次**只**见**窗口内**五个**版本**记录**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与 **IAAI**（**拍卖行**本身）的**关系**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**数据**由 **`Rebrowser`** 发布**，**本词条**不**推断**其**已获**授权**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**字段**定义**与**单位**（**⭐ 故**本词条**不**引用**任何**字段**值**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **非商业**许可是**本次**实测**结论**（**逐字 **`cc-by-nc-4.0`**）**，**⚠️ 商用**前**须**自行**确认**授权**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该数据集**是**公开**样本**，**不**构成**定价**或**承保**依据**。

e.summary_en: This is a daily sample dataset of insurance salvage auction lots published by a commercial data vendor, describing itself in writing as a daily sample of auction lots with damage assessments, title status, bidding data, and branch locations across North America. **Measured this round**: published on the eighth of September inside the window with a stated version of the previous day, typed as a dataset, licensed for non-commercial attribution use, credited to the vendor as creator, and shipped as thirty-three files, namely thirty daily comma-separated files covering late July to late August with individual sizes between about ninety-five and eight hundred kilobytes, a schema file, a readme, and a growth chart. **This entry belongs to the round theme of research artefact surfaces, using research indexes to find artefacts inside the window, and it was found through a works index that showed the same title five times between the fifth and eighth of September, each with its own identifier, which is the versioned record pattern of a single dataset.** **Four things are worth reading: it is a sample rather than the full data, and that is stated in the first sentence together with the product page and three related identifiers marking it as a supplement to the commercial product, part of a dataset series, and referenced by a pricing page, so the relationship between the free portion and the paid portion is labelled; the licence is non-commercial, which usually permits coursework and research but requires separate agreement for product use; the fields cover four aspects of a salvage vehicle, namely damage assessment, title status, bidding data, and branch locations, which sets it alongside an existing entry for another salvage auction house without any field-level comparison being made here; and the publisher is a commercial data vendor rather than a research institution, so the motive is lead generation and the usable extent should be judged from the sample itself.** **No file was downloaded and no field value was used this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a daily sample dataset of insurance salvage auction lots published by a commercial data vendor, stating in writing that it is a daily sample of lots with damage assessments, title status, bidding data, and branch locations across North America. **This entry belongs to the round theme of research artefact surfaces, finding in-window artefacts through research indexes.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the record interface**:
**First, the relationship between the sample and the full data is stated in the first sentence and labelled with three related identifiers.** The record says that this is a sample of the dataset published by the vendor, that the full dataset is updated daily, and where to browse and export the complete data, and it carries related identifiers marking it as a supplement to the product page, part of a dataset series, documented by a free-datasets page, and referenced by a pricing page. **The relationship between the free portion and the paid portion can therefore be stated in metadata rather than left for a reader to infer from a product page, and any citation of such data should say that this is a sample and where the full data lives, or the conclusions will be read as covering the whole market.**
**Second, the licence is non-commercial, which directly limits use.** The licence is an attribution licence with a non-commercial restriction, so coursework, papers, and internal research are generally permitted with attribution while productisation, external services, or commercial use require separate permission, which means any portfolio page or demonstration built on it should carry the licence and the source.
**Third, the fields cover four aspects of a salvage vehicle and set the dataset alongside another auction house already on the site.** The four are damage assessment, title status, bidding data, and branch locations. **Damage assessment and title status are the two most consequential columns in total-loss and salvage disposition, since the first drives the loss adjustment and the second determines whether the vehicle can be transferred and resold, while bid data is direct evidence of salvage value; the record also carries a schema file of about thirteen kilobytes, so field definitions ship with the data, though that file was not read this round; and the relationship to the other auction house entry is simply that each publishes one dataset, with no field-level comparison made here.**
**Fourth, the publisher is a commercial data vendor rather than a research institution.** The creator is the vendor, and a related identifier points at its pricing page. **The motive is lead generation, which does not make the data unusable but does mean that the coverage, time span, and sampling of the sample should be checked on their own terms rather than assumed to represent the full distribution.**
**Fifth, the window contains several versioned records, and the finding path is reproducible.** The same title appears five times inside the window with separate identifiers for the fifth, sixth, seventh, and eighth of September, which is the versioned record pattern of one dataset, and this entry is filed on the version dated the seventh while recording the pattern. **Citing data of this kind means naming the version and the identifier rather than only the dataset title.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover another salvage auction dataset, a vehicle reliability sample, and damage recognition, **while this entry supplies the form of salvage auction data published as a lead-generating sample by a commercial vendor. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: state the relation between sample and full data; carry the licence, especially a non-commercial clause; read salvage data through its four key columns; check how a free commercial sample was drawn; and cite versioned research data with its version and identifier.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file was downloaded**, no readme content was opened and no row count or field distribution was computed, **so no claim is made about data quality, field completeness, or sample representativeness**. **Second, only metadata returned by the record interface was read**, not the readme text. **Third, whether the daily update is sustained was not verified**, only five version records inside the window being visible. **Fourth, its relationship to the auction house itself was not verified**, the record only stating that the data are published by the vendor, and no authorisation is inferred here. **Fifth, field definitions and units were not verified**, so no field value is cited. **Sixth, the non-commercial licence is a measurement from this round**, and commercial use requires separate confirmation. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the dataset is a public sample rather than a pricing or underwriting basis.**

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 Zenodo 記錄介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**樣本**」與「**全量**」的關係寫在第一段並以三個相關標識標註****——**逐字**This is a sample of the IAAI Insurance Auto Auction Dataset published by Rebrowser. The full dataset is updated daily. Browse, filter, and export the complete dataset at https://rebrowser.net/products/datasets/iaai**，**並逐字含 isSupplementTo（**產品頁**）、**isPartOf（**系列**）、**isDocumentedBy（**免費說明頁**）、**isReferencedBy（**定價頁**）**；**⭐ 即**免費份與付費份的關係可用元資料說清**。
**⭐⭐ ② 許可是非商業****——**逐字 `cc-by-nc-4.0`**；**⭐ 即**課程與研究通常可用（**需署名**）**，**商用需另議**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 欄位覆蓋殘值車四個面向****——**逐字**damage assessments, title status, bidding data, and branch locations**；**⭐ 記錄另含 `auction-listings_schema.json`（13,611 B）**，**即**字段定義隨數據發布**（**⚠️ 本次未讀其內容**）**；**⭐ 即**損傷與權屬是車險全損與殘值處置最關鍵的兩列**，**並與 [[copart-salvage-dataset]] 構成兩家對照**。
